name: PJBUMI
recent: PJBumi 在2026年10月获 Bursa 批准一拆五股拆细，11月20日与 Macquarie Bank 签订认购协议，11月24日收到认购通知，以每股 RM3.8030 配售 75,000 股新股，新股将于11月26日上市。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均大幅增长。
notable: 并与 Macquarie Bank 签订认购协议。
以每股 RM3.8030 配售 75,000 股新股，新股11月26日上市。
risks: 私募新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
私募认购价较5日成交量加权均价折让约9.98%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM2,135,000，环比增长53.6%，同比增长907.1%；净利为 RM1,109,000，环比增长746.6%，净利率从上一季的9.4%升至51.9%。

recent_en: PJBumi obtained Bursa approval for a one-into-five share split in October 2026 and proposed a private placement of up to 10% of issued shares on 15 October; on 20 November it signed a subscription agreement with Macquarie Bank and on 24 November received a subscription notice for 75,000 new shares at RM3.8030 each, with the new shares to be listed on 26 November. Revenue and net profit rose sharply in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Received Bursa approval for the proposed one-into-five share split.
Proposed a private placement of up to 10% of issued shares and signed a subscription agreement with Macquarie Bank.
Placed out 75,000 new shares at RM3.8030 each, with the new shares listed on 26 November.
risks_en: The private placement may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The placement price represents a discount of about 9.98% to the 5-day VWAP.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2,135,000, up 53.6% QoQ and 907.1% YoY; net profit was RM1,109,000, up 746.6% QoQ, with net margin rising to 51.9% from 9.4% in the previous quarter.
